09e5a2a0aacc28eb3992e78658c1c0c7824ad480.identity: Concealed Edge batch tasking and reverse SSH
evidence: Base64 HTML fetches a blob and clicks an anchor download.
copy /b writes the downloaded wildcard fragments to the cmd /c script path.
cmd output is uploaded through curl --data-binary using the same path.
Downloads an SSH identity, changes its owner/ACL and opens root reverse forwarding with host-key verification disabled.
limitations: The direct-IP fetch retrieves an SSH identity, not browser tasking.

evidence: Main (RVA 0x2908) wires the keyboard, clipboard, screenshot and command workers and tampers with Defender, accounts and persistence.
Keylogger SendLoop (RVA 0x22e8) appends recorded keys and passes KEYLOG records to SendToC2.
Reverse-shell workers (RVAs 0x3b88, 0x3b10, 0x3b4c) couple TcpClient streams to cmd stdin/stdout.
Encryption worker (RVA 0x4718) reads files, attempts AES transformation, writes a suffixed result and deletes the original.
limitations: Self-assigned NanoCore labels do not establish the genuine NanoCore family.
Configured domain includes http://; SendToC2 and tasking prepend another http://, and TcpClient receives a URL rather than hostname.
AES IV is 14 bytes, so setting the IV fails before file replacement.
Microphone code uses generated bytes; hollowing code does not establish genuine process hollowing.

evidence: CRT entry calls WinMain at 0x401cb0. Config mode 3 calls Active Setup installer 0x401900 then self-delete 0x401390.
Installer writes HKLM Active Setup StubPath, reads and patches its own image and writes a copy.
Other branches extract DLL resource 101 (0x402460), write it and call remote injector 0x401150.
Injector allocates/writes a DLL path remotely, resolves LoadLibraryA and uses that export as CreateRemoteThread entry.
limitations: No WannaCry filesystem encryption or SMB exploit established.
Resource section is zeroed and IAT slots contain captured addresses, zeros and overwritten GUID bytes; successful DLL injection is not established.
Trailing UTF-16 records include host file paths and IDs; no entry-path decoding or execution of an appended payload was established.
